Grocery runs on the thinnest margins and the shortest freshness clocks: ordering precision, waste reduction and store labor efficiency decide survival. Fresh-chain intelligence — demand by day-part, markdown automation, cold-chain truth — is the difference.

items: Store ordering anchored to history; seasonal and local shifts missed.
Day-part and weather-driven demand unmodeled; waste and OOS coexist.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Intelligent Document Processing, Process & Task Mining, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Fresh ordering, Markdown management, Cold-chain monitoring) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food-safety (HACCP) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
